title: Are Production Cloud Skills Adequately Tested? Measuring and Governing Skill Test Adequacy in Practice
abstract: arXiv:2607.22015v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Cloud platforms increasingly deliver reusable Cloud Skills that guide AI agents through multi-step resource operations, user choices, validation, and recovery. Existing Skill evaluation primarily measures whether a Skill improves task success, but passing the available testcases does not reveal which behaviors specified by the Skill remain untested. We introduce Skill Test Adequacy, a scenario-conditioned criterion that evaluates a test suite against the complete set of operational test obligations specified by a Skill. Given a Skill package and normalized testcases containing a prompt, an initial resource state, and expected user decisions, the assessment determines whether each obligation is exercised by at least one testcase scenario; the resulting records provide both a suite-level score and explicit test gaps. translated_title: 生产云技能是否得到充分测试？测量并治理实践中的技能测试充分性
translated_abstract: 云平台日益提供可重用的云技能，这些技能引导AI代理完成多步骤的资源操作、用户选择、验证和恢复。现有技能评估主要衡量技能是否提高任务成功率，但通过现有测试用例并不能揭示技能指定的哪些行为仍未得到测试。我们引入技能测试充分性，这是一种场景条件化标准，用于评估测试套件是否覆盖技能指定的全部操作测试义务。给定技能包和标准化测试用例（包含提示、初始资源状态和预期用户决策），评估确定每个义务是否由至少一个测试用例场景执行；生成的记录提供套件级分数和明确的测试缺口。我们通过并行义务提案、保留分歧的聚合、测试用例级验证来操作化该标准。
tldr: 本文提出“技能测试充分性”新标准，用于评估云技能测试套件是否覆盖所有操作义务，并识别测试缺口，从而提升生产环境中AI代理技能的可靠性和治理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "Skill Test Adequacy," a novel criterion to assess whether cloud skill test suites cover all operational obligations, identifying test gaps to enhance reliability and governance of AI agent skills in production.
